title: Falto, Lord of Thunder
summary: Clear the burning and blazing mephits to summon Falto, Lord of Thunder.
overview: Clear the burning and blazing mephits to summon Falto, Lord of Thunder.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: The event stages a decrepit ent and a field of mephits. The boss trigger specifically checks that no burning or blazing mephits remain.
Sweep the whole event area for stragglers before expecting Falto to appear.
Once the final required mephit is gone, gather the group at the trigger location and engage Falto.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.
The reviewed controller establishes Falto’s spawn objective but does not define additional boss health phases.
